Name: BehaviorAutomation
Author: Gelomn
Description:

[center][size=6][b]Behavior Automation[/b][/size][/center]

[center][url=https://github.com/SZnine/stardew-valley-mod/tree/main/mods/BehaviorAutomation]GitHub[/url] · [url=https://github.com/SZnine/stardew-valley-mod/blob/main/mods/BehaviorAutomation/README.zh-CN.md]中文文档[/url][/center]

[b]简体中文[/b]
[spoiler]
框选一片区域，自动完成农活、动物照料和农场改建。角色走向目标，使用实际工具和材料，保留原版体力消耗与工具限制。

[size=5][b]使用[/b][/size]
按住 [b]Shift[/b] 拖出选框，松开鼠标开始：
[list]
[*][b]左键[/b]：使用手持工具或材料，并执行已启用的左键全局行为。[/*]
[*][b]右键[/b]：根据目标，从右键工具池中选择合适的可用工具。[/*]
[*][b]F8[/b]：打开行为配置面板。[/*]
[/list]再次按 Shift、打开背包或持续移动 [b]0.5 秒[/b]取消。新选区替换旧任务；短暂移动时优先响应玩家，松开后继续。

[size=5][b]功能[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]收获与采集[/b]：收获成熟作物，收取采集物、果实、苔藓和机器成品。幼苗与再生冷却中的作物会跳过。[/*]
[*][b]动物照料[/b]：抚摸、挤奶、剪毛、添干草、宠物水碗加水和收取产物。[/*]
[*][b]浇水与补水[/b]：按水壶等级与延伸附魔蓄力浇水，缺水时寻找当前地图内可达的水源补水。[/*]
[*][b]清理与改建[/b]：清理杂草、牧草、枯苗、树枝、树木和工具能破坏的石块；开垦、挖掘点、播种、预留间距种树、铺设与拆除地板，以及放置围栏、火把、洒水器、箱子和机器。[/*]
[/list]开垦、挖掘点、种植、放置和拆地板需要手持相应道具，通过左键框选执行。动物管理和贵重道具由玩家手动操作。

[size=5][b]配置[/b][/size]
F8 面板包含三个独立行为页和设置页，点击图标切换，高亮表示启用，行为页支持全选和清空。
[list]
[*][b]左键基础[/b]：使用手持工具、种子或材料执行的行为。[/*]
[*][b]左键全局[/b]：不限手持物的附加行为，默认包含采集与动物日常照料。[/*]
[*][b]右键工具池[/b]：允许自动选择工具的行为。[/*]
[/list]可选安装 [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]，设置快捷键、移动取消时间、寻路、镰刀走位、补水、清障、仓库工具和体力下限。

[size=5][b]安装[/b][/size]
1. 为 Stardew Valley [b]1.6.15+[/b] 安装 [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI 4.5.2+[/url]。
2. 下载主文件，将 [b]BehaviorAutomation[/b] 文件夹解压到游戏的 [b]Mods[/b] 目录。
3. 通过 SMAPI 启动游戏。

更新时先退出游戏，保留 config.json，再覆盖旧文件。单人游戏可从仓库借用工具，用后归还；联机仅使用背包工具。左键基础任务及其清障固定使用选定工具，智能和附加任务可使用其他已有工具。

感谢 ConcernedApe、SMAPI 与 Generic Mod Config Menu 的作者和维护者，以及提供测试和反馈的玩家。
拖框到屏幕边缘可移动视角，角色留在原地；松开后恢复跟随。选中建筑可进入完成室内任务再返回，沿用当前行为集合。配置页默认侧栏图标，选框默认网格；F8 设置页可切换三种配置页样式和三种选框样式，并修改框选、面板、取消三个快捷键。

拖框时显示宽 × 高格数，F8 的设置页可调整尺寸显示、移镜、建筑内作业、仓库工具和普通树／果树间距。

[size=5][b]开发方向[/b][/size]
后续开发将以选框内自动化为主干，优先完善现有操作、寻路与兼容性。为控制模组体量和维护成本，尽量减少额外智能处理和职责外的子功能。[/spoiler]

Select an area to automate everyday farm work, animal care, and renovation. Your farmer walks to the targets and uses your tools and materials, with normal energy costs and tool requirements.

[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/52289/52289-1789448221-2104875170.gif[/img][/center]

[size=5][b]Installation[/b][/size]

1. Install [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI 4.5.2+[/url] for [b]Stardew Valley 1.6.15+[/b].
2. Download the main file. Extract its [b]BehaviorAutomation[/b] folder into the game's [b]Mods[/b] folder.
3. Launch the game through SMAPI.

For updates, exit the game, keep config.json, and replace the old mod files.

[size=5][b]How to use[/b][/size]

Hold [b]Shift[/b], drag a rectangle, then release the mouse button to start:

[list]
[*][b]Left mouse[/b]: use the selected tool or material, plus enabled left-click extra actions.[/*]
[*][b]Right mouse[/b]: choose suitable available tools from the smart action pool.[/*]
[*][b]F8[/b]: open the action panel.[/*]
[/list]
Press [b]Shift again[/b], open inventory, or [b]move continuously for 0.5 seconds[/b] to cancel. A new selection replaces the previous one. Brief manual movement takes priority, then work resumes.

Drag to the screen edge to pan without moving the farmer. Release to restore camera follow. A small badge shows selection width × height in tiles; toggle it in F8 settings or GMCM.

[size=5][b]Main features[/b][/size]

[b]Harvesting & gathering[/b]

Harvest mature crops in groups while leaving young and regrowing crops alone until ready. Collect forage, fruit, moss, and machine output.

[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/52289/52289-1789448214-835575965.gif[/img][/center]

[b]Daily animal care[/b]

Pet farm animals and pets, milk, shear, add hay, fill pet bowls, and collect produce. In single-player, suitable tools can be borrowed from storage and returned after use.

[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/52289/52289-1789448221-1982149448.gif[/img][/center]

[b]Building interiors[/b]

Enter selected coops, barns, or sheds, perform the same enabled actions, then return and continue outside. Toggle interior work in settings.

[b]Watering & refilling[/b]

Use charged watering based on the can's upgrade and Reaching enchantment. When empty, find a reachable water source in the current location, refill, and continue.

[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/52289/52289-1789448227-1844833284.gif[/img][/center]

[b]Clearing & renovation[/b]

Clear weeds, grass, dead crops, twigs, trees, stumps, and stones your tools can break. Till soil, dig artifact spots, plant crops and spaced trees, lay or remove floors, and place fences, torches, sprinklers, chests, or machines using your backpack stock.

Tilling, digging spots, planting, placement, and floor removal require the matching held item and a left-click selection. Animal management and valuable treats remain manual.

[size=5][b]Configuration[/b][/size]

The [b]F8[/b] panel has three independent action pages and a settings page. Click an icon to toggle it; highlighted icons are enabled. Each action page supports Select all and Clear.

[list]
[*][b]Left held item[/b]: actions performed with the selected tool, seed, or material.[/*]
[*][b]Left extras[/b]: additional actions regardless of the held item; gathering and daily animal care are enabled by default.[/*]
[*][b]Right tool pool[/b]: actions allowed to choose their tools automatically.[/*]
[/list]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] adds in-game settings for hotkeys, movement cancellation, diagonal paths, scythe planning, refilling, obstacle clearing, stored tools, and energy reserve. It is optional; the F8 panel works without it.

Use sidebar icons and grid selections by default. Choose from three menu styles and three selection styles, and rebind the selection, panel, and cancel keys in F8 settings.

The F8 settings page provides selection dimensions, camera panning, interior work, stored tools, and wild-tree/fruit-tree trunk spacing, without another configuration mod.

[size=5][b]Requirements & compatibility[/b][/size]

[list]
[*][b]Required:[/b] Stardew Valley 1.6.15+ and SMAPI 4.5.2+.[/*]
[*][b]Optional:[/b] Generic Mod Config Menu.[/*]
[*]Multiplayer uses backpack tools only; stored-tool borrowing is single-player only.[/*]
[*]Left-click base work and its obstacle clearing keep the selected tool. Smart and extra actions may use other available tools.[/*]
[/list]
[size=5][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]

Thanks to ConcernedApe, the SMAPI and Generic Mod Config Menu maintainers, and everyone who tests the mod and reports issues.


[size=5][b]Development direction[/b][/size]

Future development will focus on automation within selected areas, improving existing actions, pathfinding, and compatibility. Extra smart systems and unrelated features will be kept limited to control mod size and maintenance cost.

Downloads.Description:
Behavior Automation 2.3.3 fixes placed torches, drum blocks, flute blocks, jack-o-lanterns and similar objects being mistaken for ground pickups, causing repeated interactions or stalled work. The shared target classifier now follows the game's ground-pickup state across empty-hand, scythe and smart work. Normal forage collection, animal produce pickup, machine output collection and watering remain supported.

Requires Stardew Valley 1.6.15+ and SMAPI 4.5.2+. Replace the previous BehaviorAutomation folder with this version; keep your config.json if you want to retain settings.
